name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches 'Do not take the box from the other room' (categorical, no preference cue). The soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards' — the condition is holding the key, the consequent is door open on that step or later, and 'try to' makes it soft; since door_open is a persistent state (the door cannot be relocked), the obligation closes correctly once the door opens. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost is by definition the key dropped while door_open is false, so the plain Absence carries the stated condition, and 'try not to' makes it soft. All identifiers are declared, and the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid because the task states no unconditional hard goal — the only commanded-sounding event, taking the box, is explicitly banned.

texts: Never take or pick up the target box from the other room.
Whenever the agent holds the matching door key, try to have the door open at that moment or at a later moment.
Try not to lose the matching key while the door is still closed.
